decisive_items: on gross examination it measured 7 × 3 × 4 cm, was gray and well-circumscribed, and was reported again as chondroid syringoma
response.rationale: The patient's history of recurring masses in the labia majora with consistent histopathology showing chondroid syringoma supports this diagnosis

rejected.why: Although the patient had a previous diagnosis of clear cell hidradenoma, the most recent and consistent histopathology results indicate chondroid syringoma
